summary_en: 6,250,000 ordinary shares cancelled as of 2026-06-01, reducing issued share count from 292,243,496 to 285,993,496 (2.13% reduction). Cancellation authorized by Companies Act Article 178; board resolution 2026-04-30.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: NGK Corporation completed the cancellation of 6,250,000 ordinary shares on 2026-06-01 pursuant to a board resolution dated 2026-04-30 under Companies Act Article 178. The cancellation reduced the total issued shares from 292,243,496 to 285,993,496 shares, representing a 2.13% reduction in shares outstanding. No pricing information or acquisition method details are disclosed in the filing.
